basic_info.description: Discover this exquisite residence on the 31st floor of South Beach's prestigious luxury high-rise, The Harrison. 31C is a Ken Fulk-designed two-bedroom, two-bathroom luxury high-rise abode which offers splendid features and breathtaking vistas. Enjoy panoramic views of the Bay Bridge and Downtown San Francisco from this chic urban haven.  Living at The Harrison means affords access to top-tier amenities, evoking a high-end resort lifestyle. You'll appreciate concierge services, valet parking, a heated pool and hot tub, a well-equipped gym, yoga studio, a resident lounge for entertaining, a 24-hour doorman, and the renowned 49th-floor sky lounge, Harry's Club, designed by Ken Fulk. The Pantry is a special amenity on the first floor that includes coffee, tea, and pastry service for residents to enjoy. The outdoor resident lounge is equipped with a sculpturesque fireplace, seating, and gourmet BBQ pit.   The residence's prime location is enchanting, nearby iconic landmarks and attractions such as the Embarcadero, Oracle Park, Chase Center, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, SF MoMA, FiDi, Jackson Square, and more. Experience and explore the vibrant culture, dining, and entertainment that make San Francisco one of the world's greatest cities.
